title: Q3 Compact Sprint: Align Hosted API Feature Gates with Model-Tiering Signals
creator: Amina Roy
description: Define a compact, execution-focused roadmap for Q3 that ties hosted API feature gating to dynamic model-tiering signals. Objective: produce a prioritized backlog and gating rubric that will let us automatically choose model variants for hosted endpoints based on cost/latency/quality signals and customer cohorts. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Research, and Console UX workstreams and surfaces risks, metrics, and handoffs required for the Q3 sprint bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Backlog of up to 10 scoped tickets (user stories) prioritized for Q3 sprint bundle
Gating rubric document that maps runtime signals (latency, token-cost, model-health) to model-tier decisions
Stakeholder signoff from Eng, Research, and Console teams recorded in Confluence
Runbook for canary + fallback behavior documented with rollout windows and guardrails
Success metrics defined (p50/p90 latency, avg token cost delta, quality regression thresholds) and dashboard mockups for Console
notes: Kickoff 2026-02-12: aligned on scope — focus on automatic tier selection and two hosted API features (per-route model_hint and runtime_fallback_policy).
Trade-offs discussed: stronger caching vs. aggressive tier downscaling; agreed to prefer conservative tier changes in first tranche.
Research ask: provide baseline quality delta matrix for candidate model variants (top-3) by 2026-03-05.
Operations impact: Dedicated capacity customers will be excluded from automatic tiering unless they opt in (privacy/SLAs).
Linked artifact: Q3 compact plan doc and spreadsheet with prioritized signals and thresholds.
